info.name: Get employee from organization integrated with external benefits vendor

params.name: id
params.description: Id from the legal entity to fetch data

params.name: employee_id
params.description: Employee id from the legal entity to fetch data

params.name: active_contracts
params.description: Fetch only active contracts for employees

items.docs:
Returns profile and contract data for a single employee within a legal entity integrated with an external benefits vendor. When `active_contracts` is `true`, only active contracts are included in the response.

**Related endpoints**
- use `contract_id` from contracts in response with `GET /benefits/legal-entities/{legal_entity_id}/contracts/{contract_id}/plans/{plan_id}`
